versions.content: The RSA public key in the format CRYPTO_KE_FORMAT_BIN _I DENT_RSA_PUBLICKEY is provided as follows: PublicKeyInfo ::= SEQUENCE { KeyAlgorithmIdentifier ::= AlgorithmIdentifier, publicKey ::= RSAPublicKey } Explanation: Considering RFC5280, section 4.1, the SubjectPublicKeyInfo follows direc tly the definition described above. Thus, a key type of CRYPTO_KE_FORMAT_BIN_IDENT_PUBLICKEY matches SubjectPublicKeyInfo and CRYPTO_KE_FORMAT_BIN _RSA_PUBLICKEY matches the subjectPublicKey in this definition.
